info.title: Baigamats API
info.description:
Read your online shop and orders, create invoices, ask customers to pay by mobile money, and read your payments and balance.

AUTHENTICATION: two kinds. (1) Business calls need an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer bgm_live_...`. A business creates keys in Baigamats under Settings, then API keys, and ticks the permissions each key may use (shop:read, orders:read, invoices:read, invoices:write, invoices:mark_paid, collections:read, collections:write, balance:read, account:read, inventory:read, inventory:write, sales:read, bills:read, bills:write, webhooks:manage). Give each key only the permissions it needs; bills:write lets a key spend the business balance on bills and airtime. Keys are for servers: never put one in a website or app that customers can open. A key can be revoked at any time. The key identifies the business: you never send a business id. (2) People (the mobile and web apps) sign in with /auth/login, then /auth/mfa/verify if two-step login is on, and use /auth/refresh before the access token expires. The /auth calls need no key.

LIMITS: 120 requests a minute per key. Asking a customer to pay (POST /invoices/{id}/collect) is also limited per payer number and per server address, to protect customers from repeated prompts.

MONEY: all amounts are whole UGX. An invoice is marked paid only when the payment is confirmed by the mobile money network; poll GET /collections/{id} or GET /invoices/{id} (or wait for it to turn paid). Payer fees are added on top of the invoice total at payment time, as on the payment page.

ERRORS: `{ "error": { "code": "...", "message": "..." } }` with the usual HTTP status codes (400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 422, 429).

post.description: Email or username and password. If the person has two-step login the answer is `mfa_required: true` with a `factor_id` and an `mfa_session`; send those with the six-digit code to /auth/mfa/verify. Otherwise the answer carries the session. Limited per address and per login ID.

login_id.description: An email address or a staff username.

200.description: Signed in, or the authenticator code is needed

post.description: The six-digit authenticator code, with the `factor_id` and `mfa_session` from /auth/login. Returns the session.
Send the refresh token. You get a new access token and a NEW refresh token; the one you sent stops working, so always store the new one.
Ends the session of the access token sent in the Authorization header. `scope`: `local` (default, this session), `global` (every device) or `others` (all except this one).

The same sign-up as the website: a confirmation email is sent. After confirming, the person signs in and sets up their business. The answer is the same whether or not the address already has an account. Limited to 5 a hour per address.

get.description: Needs orders:read. The id can be the order id or the order number.

post.description: Needs invoices:write. Sending the same `reference` again returns the invoice already created (HTTP 200) instead of making another, so a retry never bills twice. The customer is notified only when `send` is true (it uses the business's own SMS and email credit); otherwise use the returned `pay_url` yourself.

200.description: An invoice with this reference already existed

get.description: Needs invoices:read. The id can be the invoice id or the invoice number such as BILL-12345678.

post.summary: Ask a customer to pay an invoice by mobile money
post.description: Needs collections:write. Sends a payment prompt to the payer's phone for the invoice total (payer fee added on top). Returns at once with a collection id; the invoice turns paid only when the payment is confirmed.

phone.description: The MTN or Airtel number that will approve the payment.

get.summary: One collection and where it stands
get.description: Needs collections:read. While pending, this also asks the payment network, so a payment that was approved shows as successful straight away.
Needs account:read. Shows the key's name, permissions and expiry, and the business it belongs to.
Needs balance:read. Every movement of the business balance: payments in, settlements, bill payments, refunds.
Needs account:read. For an amount you want to receive by mobile money, returns what the payer is asked to pay and the fee (added on top by default).
Needs invoices:read. Returns the PDF and web page links: the invoice while pending, the receipt once paid.

post.description: Needs invoices:mark_paid. A paid invoice cannot be voided.

post.summary: Send the invoice to the customer again
post.description: Needs invoices:mark_paid. Uses the business's own SMS and email credit. Limited to 3 resends an hour per invoice.

post.summary: Mark an invoice paid (cash, bank, cheque)
post.description: Needs invoices:mark_paid. For money the business received itself. It issues the receipt and takes stock off. Mobile money paid through Baigamats marks the invoice paid by itself.

get.description: Needs inventory:read. The id can be the product id or the sku.

patch.description: Needs inventory:write. Stock is changed only through /adjust.

post.description: Needs inventory:write. Atomic, so two calls at once never clash. Stock cannot go below zero.

delta.description: Positive adds stock, negative removes it.

get.description: Needs sales:read. The id can be the sale id or the sale number.
Needs bills:read. Lists NWSC, UEDCL, DSTV, GOTV, STARTIMES, AIRTIME, DATA_MTN and DATA_AIRTEL, whichever are enabled for the business.

post.summary: Check a meter, account or smartcard number
post.description: Needs bills:read. Returns the customer's name so you can confirm before paying.

option.description: Water area or electricity type, where the biller needs one.

post.summary: Pay a bill or buy data
post.description: Needs bills:write. Pays from the business balance: the amount plus fee is held first and returned if the payment fails. The business's payment limits apply, and an identical payment inside a minute is refused. A status of pending means the provider has not confirmed yet; the money stays held.

200.description: Payment made but not confirmed yet (pending)

post.description: Needs bills:write. For an MTN or Airtel number, paid from the business balance. Same rules as /bills/pay.

get.summary: List bill, airtime and data payments (newest first)
One bill, airtime or data payment

post.description: Needs webhooks:manage. Baigamats calls your https address when something happens, instead of you polling. The `secret` in the answer is shown once: use it to check the Baigamats-Signature header (t=timestamp,v1=HMAC-SHA256 of `timestamp.body`). Events: order.created, order.paid, order.status_changed, invoice.paid, collection.succeeded, collection.failed. Up to 5 addresses. A failed call is retried over several hours.
Needs webhooks:manage. Calls the address now and reports what it answered.

get.description: Needs balance:read. The money in your Baigamats balance that you can settle or spend, in UGX.

bearer.description: Authorization: Bearer bgm_live_... (an API key). A signed-in access token from /auth/login is also accepted on every endpoint below: admins get every permission, staff the read ones.

customer.description: Give a phone or an email if you set send to true.

reference.description: Your own reference. Also makes the call safe to retry.

discount.description: A fixed amount in UGX taken off the items.

send.description: Send the invoice to the customer by SMS and email (uses the business's own credit).

pay_url.description: A link where the customer can pay. Present while the invoice is pending.

amount_charged.description: What the payer was asked to pay, fees included.

token.description: Electricity token, where the biller issues one.

secret.description: Only in the answer to POST /webhooks, once.
